name: portret
description: Build a dossier on a person: recall everything the vault already knows, map their public profiles by web research, emit a deep-research prompt for external tools, and persist a well-linked person card. Triggers: "/portret <name>", "dossier on <name>", "profile <name>".

findings.excerpt: `WebSearch`/`WebFetch` (Chrome MCP when paywalled). Build a table: X/Twitter, Telegram (channel + personal), Medium/Substack/blog, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram
